9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: Turning the same thought over again and again without moving towards an action.
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: Turning the same thought over again and again without moving towards an action.
同じ考えを何度も繰り返し、答えや行動に結びつけないこと。

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: 같은 생각이나 걱정을 끝없이 되풀이하면서 실제로 행동하거나 문제를 해결하지 않는 상태이다. 단순히 곱씹는 것과 달리 해법이나 다음 단계로 나아가지 못하는 데 초점을 둔다.
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: 같은 생각을 되풀이하며 행동으로 나아가지 않는 것.

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: A atividade mental de repetir um pensamento por um longo período, quase sempre sem chegar a uma solução ou mudar a situação. Diferente de uma reflexão produtiva, a ruminação mantém o ciclo.
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: Revolver o mesmo pensamento repetidamente sem avançar para uma ação.

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: Proses mengulang thoughts atau masalah yang sama terus-menerus dalam pikiran tanpa progressing ke tindakan nyata. Kata ini sering digunakan untuk menggambarkan rasaAudience yang traduz_MARGIN.
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: Mengulang thoughts yang sama terus-menerus tanpa bergerak menuju tindakan.

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: การหมุนความคิดหรือความกังวลเรื่องเดียวกันซ้ำ ๆ อย่างไม่ได้เปลี่ยนไปสู่การกระทำหรือข้อสรุป
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: การครุ่นคิดเรื่องเดิมซ้ำโดยไม่ลงมือทำ

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.definition: Bir düşünce veya olay üzerinde sürekli dönmek; çözüm aramak yerine aynı kaygıları yeniden yaşamak. Bu süreçte harekete geçme yönünde belirgin bir ilerleme olmaz.
9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.gloss: Aynı düşünceyi tekrar tekrar ele almak, ancak eyleme ilerlememek.

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.translation: Ruminasyonu günlerce sürdü; başlattığı tartışma, üzerinde düşündüğü tartışma hiç değildi.
เธอครุ่นคิดเรื่องเดิมไปหลายวัน จนข้อโต้แย้งที่เธอเริ่มไม่ใช่เรื่องที่เธอคิดอยู่
Ruminasi tentang kesalahan yang sudah lewat Daniela berlangsung selama berhari-hari, tanpa ada tindakan nyata yang dia lakukan.
A ruminação durou dias, e a discussão que ela começou não era sobre o assunto em que ficava pensando.
그녀는 며칠 동안 같은 생각에 머물렀고, 그녀가 시작한 다툼은 she'd 생각하고 있던 문제와도 달랐다.
彼女の反芻は数日間続いたが、彼女が口にした議論は、ずっと考えていたものとは違っていた。

9a12e7de47ae1e2ddbd61fb640569c573b5e9efd.text: Her rumination ran for days, and the argument she started was never the one she had been thinking about.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: Water moving in the wrong direction, back along the pipe towards the pump.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: Water moving in the wrong direction, back along the pipe towards the pump.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: 供給や排水flowsの正常的な向きとは逆に、水が pipe 内を pump 側へ流れる現象。ポンプの損傷や汚染を防ぐため、防止装置や確認が必要である。
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: 水が逆向きに流れ、pipe をたどって pump へ戻ること。

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: 공급이 끊기거나 압력이 낮아질 때 물이 역류하여 펌프 쪽으로 돌아가는 현상이다. 펌프나 배관의 손상 및 안전 문제를 일으킬 수 있다.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: 물이 잘못된 방향으로 흘러 관을 따라 펌프 쪽으로 되돌아가는 현상.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: Movimento da água na direção errada, pelo cano, de volta para a bomba.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: Movimento da água na direção errada, pelo cano, de volta para a bomba.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: Aliran air ke arah yang salah, kembali sepanjang pipa menuju pompa. Kondisi ini dapat terjadi ketika tekanan atau pasokan air berubah.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: Air yang mengalir ke arah salah, kembali sepanjang pipa menuju pompa.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: การไหลของน้ำย้อนกลับไปตามท่อในทิศทางที่ผิด มักเกิดเมื่อแหล่งจ่ายน้ำหยุดหรือแรงดันเปลี่ยนไป
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: การไหลของน้ำย้อนกลับไปตามท่อในทิศทางที่ผิด

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.definition: Suyun ters yönde, boru boyunca pompaya doğru geri hareket etmesi. Su beslemesi kesildiğinde ya da basınç değiştiğinde oluşabilir ve pompayı kuru çalıştırabilir.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.gloss: Suyun ters yönde, boru boyunca pompaya doğru geri hareket etmesi.

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.translation: Besleme kesildikten sonra geri akış, pompayı su olmadan çalışır durumda bırakabilir.
เมื่อแหล่งจ่ายน้ำหยุด น้ำอาจไหลย้อนกลับจนทำให้ปั๊มทำงานโดยไม่มีน้ำ
Setelah pasokan berhenti, aliran balik dapat membuat pompa tetap berjalan tanpa air.
Depois que o fornecimento para, o refluxo pode deixar a bomba funcionando sem água.
공급이 중단되면 역류 때문에 물이 없어도 펌프가 계속 돌 수 있다.
供給が止まると、逆流によってポンプが水のないまま動き続けることがある。

9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.text: After the supply stops, backflow can leave the pump running with no water.
9a6e496bbb00d1da28b368eadbaaa0d05c5e4499.translation: Sau khi nguồn nước ngừng, dòng chảy ngược có thể để bơm tiếp tục chạy khi không có nước.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: To say out loud that you need it. It is not the same as complaining.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.gloss: To say out loud that you need it. It is not the same as complaining.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: 自分にはできないEquipや作業を手伝ってほしいと，明確に伝えること。不平を訴えるのとは区別される。
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.gloss: 必要な助けを口頭で頼むこと。愚痴や不満を言うこととは異なる。

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: 다른 사람의 도움을 필요로 한다는 사실을 분명히 알리며 요청하는 행동을 한다. 불평이나 명령으로 표현하는 것과는 다르다.
Manifestação clara de que se precisa de ajuda; unlike uma reclamação, expressa uma necessidade em vez de apenas搞清楚 ou contestar algo.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.gloss: Ação de solicitar assistance a outra pessoa.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: Ungkapan atau permintaan yang disampaikan secara langsung ketika seseorang memerlukan bantuan. Keadaan ini berbeda dari keluhan, yang biasanya hanya menyampaikan masalah tanpa meminta pertolongan.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.gloss: Menyatakan dengan terang bahwa seseorang membutuhkan bantuan.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: การแจ้งอย่างตรงไปตรงมาว่าตนต้องการความช่วยเหลือ ซึ่งต่างจากการบ่นหรือร้องเรียน

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.definition: Bir kişiden yardım istediğini açıkça belirtme eylemidir. Şikâyetten farklı olarak kişinin neye ihtiyaç duyduğunu doğrudan söyler.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.gloss: Yardım isteme; ihtiyaç duyduğunu açıkça söyleme.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.text: I asked for help and she came straight away.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.translation: Merdivenden taşımam için arkadaşımdan yardım istedim.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.text: I asked for help and she came straight away.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.text: I asked for help and she came straight away.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.translation: Saya meminta bantuan, dan dia langsung datang.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.text: I asked for help and she came straight away.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.translation: Quando percebi que não conseguia continuar, fiz um pedido de ajuda e ela veio imediatamente.

9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.text: I asked for help and she came straight away.
9a87610fd99a8cb6f92cb74b21f23904de316344.translation: 나는 도움을 요청했고 그녀는 바로 왔다.
